name: Paper Diorama
note: A shadow box of paper layers on translateZ: the pointer moves perspective-origin for a head-coupled, off-axis view, and a transitioned @property focus distance blurs every layer by |z − focus| scaled by the chosen aperture.

name: Dieline Fold
note: A carton net built as nested preserve-3d hinges; one registered progress value is split into staggered clamp() windows per hinge, so a single transition — or the scrubber — folds the walls, base and tuck flap in sequence.

name: Channel Letters
note: Every glyph is fifteen translateZ return layers and a face, each a fraction of one registered depth length, so the returns transition as a solid; the rig tilts toward the pointer on a spring, and the wall shadow (or, at night, the halo) is offset and blurred by that same depth.

name: Halftone Moon
note: A rotated halftone grid samples an orthographic sphere: each dot's normal is turned by the libration, lit by the phase-angle sun and sized by albedo × Lambert, so the terminator, maria and earthshine all come out of one dot pass.
